core_obligations: Settle condition (1) using that the formation of X^{awn} commutes with open coverings (proof lines 12001-12008).
For condition (2), take f in the equalizer, form the scheme theoretic image Z of f : Y^{awn} -> A^1_X, and record that Z -> X is closed, proper, finite and surjective (proof lines 12010-12028).

Prove that Z -> X is injective on field valued points using the surjectivity Y^{awn} -> Z, an algebraically closed extension of large cardinality and the universal homeomorphism (Y x_X Y)^{awn} -> Y^{awn} x_X Y^{awn}, then conclude that Z -> X is a universal homeomorphism and lift f through the universal property of X^{awn} (proof lines 12030-12074).
proof_roadmap: The scheme theoretic image Z and its finiteness (proof lines 12010-12028).
Injectivity on field valued points by the large cardinality argument (proof lines 12030-12058).
difficulty_reason: For the big ph site (Sch/S)_{ph} the lemma asserts that the rule X -> Gamma(X^{awn}, O_{X^{awn}}) is a sheaf (statement lines 11990-11999). The proof checks conditions (1) and (2) of Topologies, Lemma labelled topologies-lemma-characterize-sheaf: condition (1) holds because the formation of X^{awn} commutes with open coverings by Morphisms, Lemma labelled morphisms-lemma-seminormalization and its proof (proof lines 12001-12008). For condition (2) it lets pi : Y -> X be a surjective proper morphism and takes f in the equalizer of the two maps Gamma(Y^{awn}, O_{Y^{awn}}) -> Gamma((Y x_X Y)^{awn}, O_{(Y x_X Y)^{awn}}); viewed as a morphism f : Y^{awn} -> A^1_X, its scheme theoretic image Z is closed in A^1_X, proper over X, and Z -> X is finite and surjective by Morphisms, Lemma labelled morphisms-lemma-scheme-theoretic-image-is-proper and Lemma labelled morphisms-lemma-finite-proper (proof lines 12010-12028). The proof then shows Z -> X is injective on field valued points: two k-points z_1, z_2 of Z equalized by Z -> X are first lifted through the surjectivity of Y^{awn} -> Z to K-points y_1, y_2, then tested against k-algebra maps K -> Omega for an algebraically closed extension of very large cardinality, where the universal homeomorphism (Y x_X Y)^{awn} -> Y^{awn} x_X Y^{awn} lets the compositions be lifted to (Y x_X Y)^{awn} and the equalizer property gives sigma_1(lambda_1) = sigma_2(lambda_2); a standard lemma on field extensions yields lambda_1 = lambda_2 (proof lines 12030-12058, where the field-theoretic step is dismissed with 'details omitted'). Consequently Z -> X is universally injective by Morphisms, Lemma labelled morphisms-lemma-universally-injective and hence a universal homeomorphism by Morphisms, Lemma labelled morphisms-lemma-universal-homeomorphism, and the map g : X^{awn} -> Z obtained from the universal property satisfies g o pi^{wan} = f, so f comes from an element of Gamma(X^{awn}, O_{X^{awn}}) (proof lines 12060-12074). Turning condition (2) into a statement about the scheme theoretic image and then proving it is a universal homeomorphism by a large-cardinality field argument is the non-formal step, so the claim is H2.
